question: What spiritual significance attaches to dying on the way to Gaṅgā?
premises: A person sets out with Gaṅgā in mind
The person travels on the path
The person releases life-breaths on the way
inference: One who dies on the path while intending to reach Gaṅgā gains the merit associated with that intention.
plain_english: Whoever, having set out for Gaṅgā, releases his life-breaths on the path.
